instructions: records[] is the cumulative semantic authority. For the current run, apply only IDs in currentExecution.applyOnlyTheseIds.
For each current execution ID, replace exactly the four fields under that record replace block.
Do not add, remove, rename, reorder, or reinterpret tags outside the supplied replacement arrays.
Do not propagate parent tags to specializations.
Do not curate any unlisted or non-current-execution archetype.

Do not modify mechanics, exactRefs, routes, classes, abilities, skills, talent trees, talents, feats, Force data, species data, backgrounds, narrative identity, scoring, BuildIntent, SuggestionScorer, Mentor, or UI ranking.
Do not modify the frozen 190-tag ontology.
Perform maintenanceRulings exactly as written; they are code/audit maintenance, not semantic discretion.
Run the existing Phase 12A validator and relevant tests after application.
Fail closed if currentExecution.requiredBaseHead is not an ancestor of the working branch or if any supplied tag is absent from the frozen ontology.

curationPolicy.primary: Identity-defining semantic signals. A matching character should receive strong archetype evidence from these tags.
curationPolicy.supporting: Strongly characteristic expressions that reinforce the identity but are not required for the archetype to remain recognizable.
rules: Exact identity evidence outranks broad class access.
A foundation class route does not automatically grant that class's common tags.
Recommended feat/talent tags are evidence, not a bag of tags to copy wholesale.
Optional routes remain supporting unless the archetype identity itself requires them.
No tag may be invented outside the frozen 190-tag ontology.
